records.title: 1464年：Adaraghir即位与Rabaghekhur对外活跃
records.description: 理念将年轻王子Adaraghir的即位明确列1464，并将此前大臣改革与此后对外活跃连接起来。此后1485保护Sardika与1503出逃沿旧稳定ID。 此为已封存MOD理念的有年叙述，证据等级保持单一游戏文本；不自动修改政权、疆界或宗属。 本地旧年表有相同或相近叙述；可能共用编纂上游，不计为已证明独立旁证。

dateEvidence.precision: explicit year in MOD narrative / diegetic quotation
dateEvidence.quote: For centuries the harimari of the Ascension Peninsula paid scarce attention to the outside world, instead focused on internal squabbles, tribal feuds, and personal aggrandizement. While the jungles made it difficult for any outside power to conquer them, the thousand petty fiefs of the Oghaprabhi were hardly a unified realm, and only a powerful hand could ever succeed in pointing all of the Peninsula’s efforts in one direction, and never for long.\n\nThis pattern of behavior finally began to change during the chaos of the mid 1400s, as the general unrest in the military and ineffectiveness of the central government shook the Senapti to action. Efforts by a new cadre of ministers under the young prince Adaraghir helped revitalize Rabaghekhur and turn its focus outwards from the jungles once again, and following the prince's ascension in 1464 Rabaghekhur began to rouse itself from its long period of inactivity and assert itself on the stage of Raheni politics.
dateEvidence.scope: context only, not inferred from unlock date

records.title: 1531年：Bahra在对魔军战斗中身亡
records.description: Bahra of the Clenched Paw固定传记明确，他持续传播Praxis并率游击信众抗击魔军，最终于1531在与大地精军队的战斗中身亡。文中未给战场和具体参战国家，不以其Rabaghekhur出身推定母国参战。后世Tiger军团与Azepyanunin重新诠释其形象，为思想传播背景，未附确年。
